column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3552, B2b-1): one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set, not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. It is the test that executes migration 004 and the scope/principal columns on each dialect, so it must run wherever a DSN is set.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3552, B2b-1): re-runs migration 004 on PostgreSQL and SQL Server only. MySQL has no arm because it has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS; its file is one atomic ALTER instead. The mssql subtest skips in this PostgreSQL-only job and the postgres one runs. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set.
